title: Site statistics
description: Small numbers the app charts: one file per site, referenced by `stats` in the manifest. Every series says how it was computed, so a teammate can answer 'where does this number come from?'.

layer.description: id of the layer this series was derived from, when there is one.

region.description: What area the number covers, in words: which box or polygon, on which grid, and which pixels count.

method.description: How the number was computed, in one or two plain sentences.

value.description: null when the value could not be computed for this date (shown as a gap, never interpolated).

n.description: Number of valid pixels behind the value.

bars.description: Comparisons across categories instead of across dates, for example a rate for each class of a classified map. Optional.

unit.description: e.g. 'detections per km2', '%'. Empty string if unitless.

layer.description: id of the classified layer whose classes the categories are, when there is one.

region.description: What area and period the numbers cover, in words.

method.description: How the numbers and their uncertainty were computed, in one or two plain sentences.

value.description: null when the value could not be computed (shown as missing, never as zero).

low.description: Lower end of the uncertainty interval named in `method`.

high.description: Upper end of the uncertainty interval named in `method`.

n.description: Count behind the value, for example the number of detections.

class.description: Pixel value of the class in `layer`, when the category is a class.
